pages.title: Alignment: Enchantment
pages.text: <thing>Enchantment/$ (light yellow) will enchant 1 item dropped in the world within 3 blocks range. They will be enchanted with a level equal to the beam <thing>power/$. If the beam <thing>power/$ >= 64, then it can get treasure enchantments (like Mending).$(br2)However, <em>any enchanted item has a chance to be destroyed/$. When an item is enchanted by this beam, there is a (power)% chance to destroy the item. For example, a power 15 beam has a 15% chance to destroy the item and an 85% chance of enchanting it at level 15. This can be disabled in the config.$(br2)This beam is very powerful, able to apply max level enchants (including mending) without costing XP.$(br2)
<thing>Void-Enchantment/$ AKA <thing>Disenchantment/$ will disenchant (including removing curses) all items dropped in the world within 3 blocks range.
